caption: The drawing features a symmetrical composition with a series of bold, curved bands radiating from the top toward the bottom corners. The bands are colored green, tan, yellow, brown, and blue, arranged from the outer edge toward the center. In the lower central part of the image, there is a white, triangular shape with a pointed tip, resembling a mountain, flanked by a series of smaller brown triangular peaks at its base. In front of the white triangular form, there are three yellow, leaf-like shapes positioned near its base. The overall composition is made up of solid, flat areas of color without gradients or shading. The background is left as the plain, off-white color of the paper.
title: Colcha
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
